title: Identification of EGR2 and TGFB1 as Potential Immunoregulatory Biomarkers for Allergic Rhinitis: An Exploratory Bioinformatics and Pilot Validation Study.
authors: Liu, Yisen; Guo, Shuo; Cao, Feng; Chen, Xixi; Liu, Yehai
journal: Medical science monitor : international medical journal of experimental and clinical research
one_liner_zh: 该研究通过生物信息学与湿实验验证识别过敏性鼻炎免疫调控生物标志物EGR2和TGFB1，虽涉及转录因子EGR2但未聚焦蛋白-DNA互作建模，且方法以表达分析与分子对接为主，缺乏AI/物理模拟的互作机制研究，与本课题关联度低。
abstract: BACKGROUND Allergic rhinitis (AR) is a common inflammatory disorder of the nasal mucosa triggered by allergens and characterized by sneezing, nasal congestion, and itching. This study aimed to identify and validate potential biomarkers associated with immune dysregulation in AR via bioinformatics analyses initiated with chemokine-related genes. MATERIAL AND METHODS AR-related datasets (GSE75011 and GSE50223) and 69 chemokine-related genes were analyzed via differential expression analysis and weighted gene co-expression network analysis to identify candidate genes. Random forest analysis was used to select optimal features. Expression analysis identified potential immunoregulatory biomarkers that were downregulated in AR samples. A nomogram incorporating these biomarkers was constructed as an exploratory tool to estimate individual AR probability and support future diagnostic model development. RESULTS Early growth response protein 2 (EGR2) and transforming growth factor-ss1 (TGFB1) were identified as chemokine-related biomarkers in AR. Immune infiltration analysis showed significant correlations between TGFB1 and M2 macrophages, as well as activated memory CD4+ T cells. Drug prediction identified tretinoin as a potential therapeutic agent targeting both biomarkers; molecular docking confirmed stable binding of the 3 top-ranked predicted drugs with TGFB1. Pilot reverse transcription-quantitative polymerase chain reaction analysis demonstrated downregulation of EGR2 and TGFB1 in AR samples, providing preliminary supportive evidence. Gene set enrichment analysis indicated involvement in the MAPK and p53 signaling pathways, suggesting roles in cell proliferation, apoptosis, cell cycle regulation, and stress responses. CONCLUSIONS EGR2 and TGFB1 offer potential immunoregulatory biomarkers for AR diagnosis and may provide preliminary insights into AR pathogenesis and potential treatment strategies.
abstract_zh: 背景 过敏性鼻炎（AR）是一种由过敏原触发、以打喷嚏、鼻塞和瘙痒为特征的常见鼻黏膜炎症性疾病。本研究旨在通过以趋化因子相关基因为起点的生物信息学分析，识别并验证与AR免疫失调相关的潜在生物标志物。材料与方法 通过差异表达分析和加权基因共表达网络分析，对AR相关数据集（GSE75011和GSE50223）及69个趋化因子相关基因进行分析，以识别候选基因。采用随机森林分析选择最优特征。表达分析识别出在AR样本中下调的潜在免疫调节生物标志物。构建了一个包含这些生物标志物的列线图，作为评估个体AR概率的探索性工具，并为未来诊断模型开发提供支持。结果 早期生长反应蛋白2（EGR2）和转化生长因子-β1（TGFB1）被鉴定为AR中的趋化因子相关生物标志物。免疫浸润分析显示，TGFB1与M2巨噬细胞及活化记忆CD4+ T细胞之间存在显著相关性。药物预测确定维A酸为靶向这两种生物标志物的潜在治疗药物；分子对接证实排名前3的预测药物与TGFB1具有稳定结合。初步逆转录定量聚合酶链反应分析显示，AR样本中EGR2和TGFB1表达下调，提供了初步支持性证据。基因集富集分析表明其参与MAPK和p53信号通路，提示在细胞增殖、凋亡、细胞周期调控及应激反应中发挥作用。结论 EGR2和TGFB1为AR诊断提供了潜在的免疫调节生物标志物，并可能为AR发病机制及潜在治疗策略提供初步见解。
